profile_tracing.jpeg.caption: Armen's pencil tracing of the fender's inner top edge (2026-09-11). Baseline with ticks at 50 and 90 mm; heights above the paper edge 28 / 24 / 10 mm at 0 / 50 / 90. Cabin end at the left, hinge (steep end) at the right. The 0 tick is just off the left edge.

ebay_hinge_closeup.jpeg.caption: eBay: hinge bar with lobed ears and outward pins

ebay_three_quarter.jpeg.caption: eBay: three-quarter view of the real ramp

ebay_edge_profile.jpeg.caption: eBay: edge-on, shows the arch and the hinge-end flange (a perspective photo, not to scale)

ebay_bottom_view.png.caption: eBay: inside face with the tray rim

web_front_iso_closed.jpeg.caption: yojoe.com right-front iso, ramp closed: the ramp's vertical front face (RAMP ACCESS label) is a band below the fender top line, roughly twice our 10 mm, and a round black hinge boss sits on the black nose at each bottom corner of it (2026-09-13)

web_front_straight_closed.jpeg.caption: Straight-on front, ramp closed (web photo): the ramp's front face is inset between the fenders' front faces, hinge at its bottom edge, sled-launch door on the black nose below (2026-09-13)

web_front_iso_open.jpeg.caption: Front iso from slightly below, ramp lowered flat to the table (web photo, BLC): the ramp pivots at the top of the black nose and lies flat; the black boss at the nose corner is the hull-side hinge (2026-09-13)
